family.description: This entry represents a domain found in the transmembrane proteins lipase maturation factor, LMF1 and LMF2. Lipoprotein lipase and hepatic lipase require LMF1 to fold into their active states [[cite:PUB00057509]]. It acts as a chaperone required for maturation and transport of active lipoprotein lipase (LPL), through the secretory pathway [[cite:PUB00057511],[cite:PUB00098585]]. This domain is predicted as a transmembrane. It contains two structural repeats each of which is similar to members of the DoxD-like superfamily.
family.name: Lipase maturation factor transmembrane domain
